name: generic-rag-chunking-2026-09-29 R-30 live census (P-016 re-measure): every harness doc collection has an embedded doc_sections row
command: dev:pg_query { allowUnscoped: true, sql: "WITH d AS (SELECT harness_slug, count(*) AS docs FROM harness_shared.harness_docs WHERE retired_at IS NULL GROUP BY harness_slug), s AS (SELECT source_key, count(*) AS n, count(embedding) AS e FROM harness_shared.doc_sections WHERE source_key LIKE 'harness:%' GROUP BY source_key) SELECT coalesce(d.harness_slug, substr(s.source_key, 9)) AS slug, d.docs, s.n AS sections, s.e AS embedded, now() AS at FROM d FULL JOIN s ON s.source_key = 'harness:' || d.harness_slug ORDER BY (coalesce(s.e,0) = 0) DESC, slug" } against the live operator DB (native PG :5432, database papercusp)
summary: 20 harness doc collections (source_key harness:<slug>), 4,152 doc_sections rows, all 4,152 embedded; 0 collections without an embedded row. Denominator cross-check: all 4 harnesses with live (non-retired) harness_docs rows (oddsmith 63 docs, papercup-rust-mobile 16, papercusp 1013, restart 54) have embedded sections, so no harness with docs is missing from doc_sections. The other 16 collections come from harness content paths the sweep reads from disk and have no harness_docs rows. The census starts from harness_docs (FULL JOIN), so a harness whose sections were never written (the R-30 mutant's failure) would appear as a row with sections null.

assertions.evidence: Every one of the 20 harness:<slug> collections has embedded = sections (> 0): brood-box-alpha 27/27, calendar 2/2, email 2/2, hive-canary 24/24, oddsmith 653/653, oddsmith-hive 653/653, oddsmith-ops 68/68, papercup-rust-mobile 176/176, papercusp 1492/1492, papercusp/libs/papercusp 33/33, papercusp/papercusp-desktop 5/5, phone-app 6/6, portal 2/2, quartermaster 6/6, quartermaster-hive 2/2, restart 836/836, shared-hive-test 4/4, shared-hive-test-hive-2 4/4, sidestage 137/137, spawn-demo 20/20.

FULL JOIN of live harness_docs per harness_slug against doc_sections per source_key returned no row with docs > 0 and sections null or embedded 0 (the query orders such rows first; the first row is brood-box-alpha with 27 embedded).
